channel.title: RankMint — Data-Driven Rankings
channel.description: Surprising, data-driven ranking indices on topics you never knew you cared about.

item.title: Boss Fight Fairness Index
item.description: The easiest boss in the dataset is the fairest. Baldur #1, Isshin #2, Bed of Chaos dead last. Malenia is top 12 fairest despite being the hardest. Difficulty and fairness are independent.

item.title: Anime Sensei Competence Index
item.description: Gojo scores lower than a volleyball team manager. Might Guy outranks Kakashi. The most powerful mentors are the worst teachers. #1: Koro-sensei with 9.70 points.

item.title: K-Drama Binge Trap Index
item.description: Romance beats thriller: Crash Landing on You is more dangerous for your sleep than Squid Game. Reply 1988 (IMDb 9.0) ranks #29. Prestige and addictiveness are orthogonal.

item.title: Startup Graveyard Index
item.description: Theranos isn't the stupidest startup death — Juicero is. WeWork ranks only #17 because it had real revenue. 30 famous failures ranked by how avoidable their deaths were.

item.title: City Ramen Value Index
item.description: Fukuoka, not Tokyo, is the world's best ramen city. New York's $22 bowls land it at #17. #1: Fukuoka with 9.21 points.

item.title: Global Nap Culture Index
item.description: Japan has the world's best nap culture and the world's worst sleep. The Netherlands has no nap culture at all and nearly beat Spain for #1. #1: Spain with 7.07 points.

item.title: Global Hangover Recovery Index
item.description: The world's best hangover country isn't Ireland, Germany, or Australia — it's the place that turned recovery into a billion-dollar science. #1: Japan with 81.8 points.

item.title: Disney Villain CEO Index
item.description: Your company's next board seat might be best filled by the god of the dead — and the data backs it up. #1: Hades with 86.9 points.
